scripts.// deploy: REFUSES ON PURPOSE. This worker has exactly ONE deployer: Cloudflare Workers Builds, connected to the repo, watching main — merging IS the deploy. A second deployer means two systems racing on the container image and on which version ends up live, and the loser silently overwrites the winner (see .github/workflows/ci.yml). It has already cost this project once: three consecutive Workers Builds failures on main/phase-2/staging while the live worker sat on a hand-uploaded version, which is the nastier half — a hand deploy does not just race, it makes prod look healthy while the pipeline is dead. SAFE TO SHIP AS A REFUSAL, verified 2026-07-31 against the real build config: Cloudflare's own deploy command is `npx wrangler deploy`, invoked DIRECTLY and not through this script, so nothing here can reach the pipeline. NOTE the asymmetry with the *.uwutoowo.com tools, where `wrangler deploy` IS the mechanism — the habit from those repos is what this stops.
scripts.deploy:
echo '
Refused. mbedfx deploys via Cloudflare Workers Builds on merge to main — merging is the deploy.
Two deployers race and the loser silently overwrites the winner.

  validate locally:  npx wrangler deploy --dry-run
  see what shipped:  npx wrangler deployments list
' && exit 1
scripts.// build: THE CI GATE, and it is not a no-op despite a Worker needing no build step. Cloudflare Workers Builds runs `npm run build` before its deploy command; with no such script the build FAILED and nothing shipped (measured 2026-07-26: three consecutive failed builds on main, phase-2 and staging, all 'Missing script: build', while the live worker sat on a hand-uploaded version). Pointing it at the suite turns that required-and-previously-broken step into the gate that was lost when deploys moved off GitHub Actions: a red suite or a type error now fails the build, so it never reaches deploy. This matters more here than on a typical worker because Discord CACHES the og:video url we serve, keyed by a url that never changes — a bad deploy outlives its own fix.
scripts.// test:container: EXECUTES container/server.py rather than reading it as text. NOT in `build`: that script is the Cloudflare Workers Builds gate and python3 is not guaranteed in that image, so a failure there would block the deploy instead of catching a bug. GitHub Actions runs it on ubuntu-latest.
